revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY23-25 revenue CAGR ~4%; moderated for Keytruda patent expiry ~2028 offset by pipeline and launches.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: operating income not filed; pretax+interest proxy FY2025 margin ~34.5%, haircut for Keytruda LOE and recurring acquisition/IPR&D charges.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate ~13% (net income 18,254 vs pretax 21,067); raised to ~16% for Pillar Two/mix normalization.

da_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 filed Depreciation 3,045 / revenue 65,011 = 4.7%, held flat (excludes intangible amortization, conservative).

wacc.source: Assumption via CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + beta ~0.8 (assumed, large-cap pharma) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~8.4% cost of equity; after-tax cost of debt ~4.5% at ~25% debt weight gives ~7.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: lowered to 1.5% (below Rf and GDP) given Keytruda LOE and to limit terminal value dependence.
